title: Bulk link creation API
summary: Add POST /api/v1/links/bulk that creates up to 100 short links in one call. Items are processed independently: each item reports either the created link or a typed error, and the call succeeds as long as the batch itself is well formed.
functionalRequirements: Accept a JSON body with an 'items' array of {url, customAlias?} objects
Reject the whole request with 400 if 'items' is missing, empty or has more than 100 entries
Create each valid item using the same validation rules as single link creation
Return one result per item in request order with index, status (CREATED or REJECTED), the link on success and a problem type plus message on failure
Return summary counts: requested, created, failed
nonFunctionalRequirements: Partial failure must not roll back successfully created items
Reuse existing URL and alias validation; no duplicated rules
Bounded request size to protect the service (max 100 items)

acceptanceCriteria.description: A batch with valid and invalid items returns 200 with CREATED results for valid items and REJECTED results with problem types for invalid ones
Items keep their request order and index in the response
An empty batch or a batch of more than 100 items is rejected with 400 problem details
A duplicate custom alias inside one batch creates the first item and rejects the second with alias-taken
Links created through the bulk endpoint resolve through GET /{code}

assumptions: Items are processed sequentially; 100 items is small enough that parallelism is not needed
Each bulk request consumes one rate-limit token; per-item weighting is a follow-up
No idempotency key for the batch in this iteration
outOfScope: Asynchronous or file-upload based bulk import

ambiguities.question: Should the HTTP status reflect partial failure (for example 207 Multi-Status)?
ambiguities.impact: Client error handling; 207 is a WebDAV status that many HTTP clients treat oddly
